_meta.author: Plato
_meta.purpose: dialogue -> valid Stephanus page range, for the range-constraint step of citation resolution
_meta.edition_of_record: Stephanus 1578 (3 vols); ranges standard in Burnet OCT (Platonis Opera, 5 vols, OUP)
_meta.reset_note: Stephanus numbers reset per VOLUME in the 1578 edition, and by convention are quoted per dialogue with the dialogue name. Ranges below are the page spans each dialogue occupies. A bare number like 511 is ambiguous across all dialogues whose range contains 511; the parser uses these ranges to shortlist candidates and lets the abbreviation + scope-tracking disambiguate.
_meta.letter_note: Stephanus pages subdivide a-e. Citations look like 511d or 327a. The page integer is what these ranges bound; the letter is within-page and does not affect range membership.
_meta.VERIFY: Every start/end pair is marked verified:false. Check each against Burnet's OCT before production use. The values here are close approximations from standard references and WILL contain errors at the boundaries (dialogues abut and the exact hand-off page is easy to misremember). Overlapping/abutting ranges across volumes are EXPECTED because the reset means the same integer recurs in different volumes.
_meta.tetralogy_note: Dialogues are grouped by Thrasyllus's 9 tetralogies as ordered in the 1578 edition / Burnet. Volume boundaries (I-III of Stephanus) noted where they fall.
_meta.verification_status: Integer ranges VERIFIED against Wikipedia (all 36 matched an independent build). verified:true set. Burnet OCT check still advised for publication-grade certainty.
